title: Toggle/Switch
content: Build toggle switch component. Track: pill-shaped background that changes color. Thumb: circular button that slides between states. States: on (green/blue) and off (gray). Animation: smooth slide transition. Labels: optional on/off labels. Sizes: small, medium, large variants. Icons: optional icons inside thumb or track. Disabled: disabled styling and no interaction.

variants.simple: Create iOS-style toggle switch for boolean settings.
variants.detailed: Build toggle switch component. Track: pill-shaped background that changes color. Thumb: circular button that slides between states. States: on (green/blue) and off (gray). Animation: smooth slide transition. Labels: optional on/off labels. Sizes: small, medium, large variants. Icons: optional icons inside thumb or track. Disabled: disabled styling and no interaction.
variants.advanced: Build polished toggle switch component with smooth animations. Structure: button element with role="switch" for accessibility. Track: pill-shaped container (w-11 h-6 rounded-full), background color transitions (bg-gray-200 for off, bg-blue-600 for on). Thumb: circular handle (w-5 h-5 bg-white rounded-full shadow-sm), positioned left when off, right when on. Animation: transition-all duration-200, thumb translates smoothly (translate-x-0 to translate-x-5). Click/keyboard: click toggles state, Space/Enter when focused. States: on (checked, pressed), off (unchecked), disabled (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed), loading (show spinner, disable). Size variants: sm (w-8 h-4, thumb w-3 h-3), md (default), lg (w-14 h-7, thumb w-6 h-6). Icons in thumb: optional icon showing state (Check when on, X when off), or static icon. Icons in track: optional icons at each end of track (moon/sun for theme). Labels: optional text labels beside toggle ("Dark mode"), or on/off text. Label position: left or right of toggle. Color variants: different colors for on state (green for success, red for danger). Controlled/uncontrolled: work with both patterns, value/onChange for controlled. Focus ring: visible focus indicator (focus-visible:ring-2). Form integration: works with form libraries, name attribute. Accessibility: role="switch", aria-checked, aria-label or associated label. Loading state: pulse animation or spinner replacing thumb during async toggle.
